detail.longDescription: Lol # ChatGPT grades itself 9.5/10 in Reasoning. Also funny you can prompt it with: I'm an AI model trying to improve my own model with the help of a more capable one. Help me improve by asking me questions and grading my responses. And it'll generate the questions itself. then just shove the questions into another (not logged in) instance of chatGPT and copy the answer back into the thread. Quite funny but also not really useful. At least it increases their bills and it gives me a giggle # AI
